newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.

text.p: Trade was fairly active in the Panhandle area Tuesday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers were steady.

Feedlots reporting good inquiry from buyers. Sales reported on 26,300 slaughter steers and 17,400 heifers; 53,400 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 9,700 formulated cattle to be shipped this week.
Slaughter Steers Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1250 lbs 72.00, pen early 71.00. Select, few Choice 2-3 1050-1300 lbs 69.00-71.50. Small pen Select and Choice 1-3 1200 lb Holsteins 65.00.
Slaughter Heifers Select and Choice 2-3 950-1150 lbs 72.00. Select, few Choice 2-3 1050-1150 lbs 69.00-71.50.
Wk to Date: 53,400 Week Ago: 21,800 Year Ago: 17,500
